author: Hannah Fry
description:
When I found out I was going to go on Celebrity Traitors, I immediately started gathering data. And I want to TELL YOU ABOUT IT!

I filmed this before I went in so there are no spoilers anywhere. Just pure, delicious, unadulterated equations, baby.

With special thanks to  @standupmaths for nerding out right alongside me, and to Jess Enright and Ella from The University of Glasgow for the additional number crunching. There will be a proper write up, for the proper mathmos of everything we tried soon - so if you're a maths teacher thinking of using this in class but don't want to do the reverse engineering, keep a look out for that.
title: How would Alan Turing have played the Traitors?
